decision: NOT PUBLISHED: link-only stays (all-or-nothing rule). No allergens.csv was written and no data changed.
notes: The booklet's allergen tables (PDF pages 2-4, red dot = contains, hollow dot = may contain) were read on 150 dpi renders. They are per component for pizzas: separate tables for Pizza Bases, Pizza Base Sauces, Cheese, Pizza Toppings and Pizza Finishers, and the 'Pizza Combinations' rows carry the booklet's own line 'Allergen Information for Pizza Combinations does not include Pizza Bases. Please see Pizza Base section and factor in the base you have chosen.' So none of the 108 published pizza items (Pan 20, Handcrafted 38, Stuffed crust 20, Cheesy Bites 10, Gluten free 10, Vegan 10) has one row of its own; the 8 Hot Honey Sriracha Chicken & Pepperoni pizzas have no combination row at all. Also without an exact row under their own names: Kids Pan / Thin / Gluten Free Margherita pizzas, Lasagne, Classic Mac 'N' Cheese, Take Away Macaroni Cheese, and kids' fries, garlic bread, onion rings, drinks, brownie and donut variants (about 20 more). Together well over a third of the 237 items, so the contract (every published item gets a row copied from the guide, nothing inferred) cannot be met. The column headed 'Fish / shellfish' also does not separate fish from crustaceans (no mark is printed in it on any row). Founder option, not done: publishing each pizza as the union of its combination row and its base row (what the booklet tells diners to do) would be derived, not copied, and would still leave about 30 items without allergens. Page 5-9 of the booklet are ingredient lists per component, not a per-dish allergen matrix.
